project.name: HSM Crypto Core
project.description: The one implementation of the DEK-level crypto formats every service and client shares (java/docs/COMPATIBILITY_CONTRACT.md C1-C4, C7): BC-FIPS bootstrap, AES-256-GCM DekManager with the v1 ciphertext token, IV generation, RSA-OAEP DEK transport wrap, and the Redis DEK cache codec. Plain Java with bc-fips as its only runtime dependency -- no Spring, no Azure SDK -- so it can sit on any classpath, including a Spark executor's. Pinned by the cross-language vectors in java/chassis/test-vectors/crypto-v1.json.
